mapper.select:
SELECT id, document_type, business_id, business_no, template_id, template_code, template_name, template_version, printed_at, printed_by FROM scm_print_record WHERE 1 = 1
AND document_type = #{query.documentType}
AND business_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.businessNo}, '%')
ORDER BY printed_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, document_type, business_id, business_no, template_id, template_code, template_name, template_version, model_snapshot, data_snapshot, printed_at, printed_by FROM scm_print_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_print_record (document_type, business_id, business_no, template_id, template_code, template_name, template_version, model_snapshot, data_snapshot, printed_at, printed_by) VALUES (#{row.documentType}, #{row.businessId}, #{row.businessNo}, #{row.templateId}, #{row.templateCode}, #{row.templateName}, #{row.templateVersion}, #{row.modelSnapshot,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{row.dataSnapshot,typeHandler=com.xsy.scm.common.json.JsonbObjectMapTypeHandler}, #{row.printedAt}, #{row.printedBy})
